title.en: Flow of control: sequence, selection and repetition
title.kn: ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣದ ಹರಿವು: ಅನುಕ್ರಮ, ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ

hook.en: Every algorithm is built from just three moves: go straight, choose a turn, or go round again. Let us see each one.
hook.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಕ್ರಮಾವಳಿಯೂ ಮೂರು ಚಲನೆಗಳಿಂದ ರಚಿತ: ನೇರ ಹೋಗು, ತಿರುವು ಆರಿಸು, ಮತ್ತೆ ಸುತ್ತು. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದನ್ನೂ ನೋಡೋಣ.

objectives.en: Identify sequence, selection and repetition in an algorithm

narration.en: Every algorithm is built from just three moves: go straight, choose a turn, or go round again. Let us see each one.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಕ್ರಮಾವಳಿಯೂ ಮೂರು ಚಲನೆಗಳಿಂದ ರಚಿತ: ನೇರ ಹೋಗು, ತಿರುವು ಆರಿಸು, ಮತ್ತೆ ಸುತ್ತು. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದನ್ನೂ ನೋಡೋಣ.

body.en: Flow of control is the order in which the steps of an algorithm are executed. In a sequence, steps run one after another. In selection, a condition is checked and one of the alternative paths is chosen, as in IF condition THEN … ELSE …. The condition evaluates to TRUE or FALSE. Selection can also check several conditions one after another.

narration.en: Flow of control is the order in which the steps of an algorithm are executed. In a sequence, steps run one after another. In selection, a condition is checked and one of the alternative paths is chosen, as in IF condition THEN … ELSE …. The condition evaluates to TRUE or FALSE. Selection can also check several conditions one after another.
narration.kn: ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣದ ಹರಿವು ಎಂದರೆ ಹಂತಗಳು ಕಾರ್ಯಗತವಾಗುವ ಕ್ರಮ. ಅನುಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಂತಗಳು ಒಂದರ ನಂತರ ಒಂದು ನಡೆಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಆಯ್ಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಷರತ್ತನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ದಾರಿಯನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ — IF … ELSE.

body.en: Repetition (iteration, or a loop) executes a set of steps again and again while a condition remains true, as in WHILE condition DO …. The loop must change something each time so that the condition eventually becomes false; otherwise it never ends. For example, to add the numbers from 1 to N, a counter goes up by 1 each time until it passes N.

points.en: Update the counter inside the loop
A loop without an exit never ends

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ (ಲೂಪ್) ಷರತ್ತು ಸತ್ಯವಾಗಿರುವವರೆಗೆ ಹಂತಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ನಡೆಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ — WHILE. ಷರತ್ತು ಒಂದು ದಿನ ಸುಳ್ಳಾಗುವಂತೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಬಾರಿ ಏನಾದರೂ ಬದಲಾಗಬೇಕು.

problem.en: Write pseudocode to print whether a number is odd or even.

answer.en: For 14 it prints Even; for 7 it prints Odd.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Write pseudocode to print whether a number is odd or even.

problem.en: Write pseudocode to find the sum of the first N natural numbers and trace it for N = 4.

steps.en: WHILE i <= N DO: sum = sum + i; INCREMENT i
Trace: sum becomes 1, 3, 6, 10 as i goes 1, 2, 3, 4; then i = 5 > 4 and the loop stops.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Write pseudocode to find the sum of the first N natural numbers and trace it for N = 4.
Team quiz. Each team discusses and gives one answer. Let us see which team scores the most.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡವೂ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ. ಯಾವ ತಂಡ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಅಂಕ ಗಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ನೋಡೋಣ.

narration.en: Now two board and CUET pattern questions. Try them on your own before we check the answers.

homework.en: Write pseudocode to find the largest of three numbers.
Write pseudocode to print the multiplication table of a number.

narration.en: Recap. Flow of control is the order in which steps run. Sequence runs steps in order; selection chooses a path. Repetition repeats steps while a condition is true; update the counter.
